name: Video Studio
intro: Video Studio in SmartVideo makes AI videos from a text prompt, from an image you upload, or from a video you already have.

features.text-to-video: Type a description in the prompt box and press Generate. Text to video is the fastest way to get a clip when you have no source picture.
features.animate-image-image-to-video: Attach a start frame image and the studio switches to image to video. Starting from your own picture gives more predictable results.
features.keyframes-start-end: The keyframes workflow starts the clip on your start frame and ends it on your end frame, which is great for transformations and controlled transitions.
features.references: The references workflow lets you guide the result with reference media, so the output can follow the look of your reference images.
features.edit-video-extend-uploaded-video-motion-: Three workflows work on footage you already have. You can edit a video, extend it, or transfer motion onto something new.
features.advanced-native-audio-and-character-lock: Open Advanced for two toggles. Native Audio asks capable models to produce sound, and Character Lock helps keep the same character across clips.
features.motion-and-style-panel: The motion and style panel has camera speed, guidance and style presets like cinematic or anime, for a quick style nudge without rewriting your prompt.
features.result-actions: Once a clip is ready, you can regenerate, download it, open it in Render to keep editing, or publish it to social.

outro: Start with words or a picture, and Video Studio gives you plenty of ways to shape your next clip.
